executiveSummary: A high-casualty earthquake struck western Colombia (Cali, Pereira, Quibdó, Manizales), killing at least 111 people with widespread building collapse and ongoing search and rescue. View Article A strong quake in Indonesia's East Nusa Tenggara/Flores region killed at least 53 people, destroyed 900+ homes, and displaced about 5,000 to temporary shelters; access and utilities were disrupted. View Article Wildfires in British Columbia's Okanagan region forced more than 20,000 evacuations, caused at least one death, and remain too dangerous for full damage assessment; lodging and reception centers were activated. View Article Typhoon conditions and a subsequent tropical storm disrupted eastern China and northern Luzon: China preemptively relocated 300,000+ people with major air/rail suspensions; in the Philippines, at least 19 died and ~98,000 were displaced (over 1 million affected). View Article Supporting Report Record flooding in Indiana killed at least five people, triggered 350+ evacuations and boat rescues, and prompted a federal emergency declaration. View Article Roughly 97 million people across the Central Plains to the Southeast (U.S.) remained under heat advisories with dangerous heat stress risk and limited overnight relief. View Article Belgium's High Fens wildfire prompted ~600 evacuations; a cross-border response was mobilized as smoke drifted into Germany. View Article
